resources.string: Listening for notifications from your chosen apps.
Know which app needs you, without reaching for your phone.
Turn Bluetooth on to send signals
Allow access to your paired Air
Allowed · only chosen apps are used
Allow Air Signals in Android Settings
Allowed · includes a Stop alerts action
Timers and alarms work independently of notification forwarding. Screen-on notification muting does not silence them. Keep your phone on and the Air nearby.
Allow Alarms & reminders and notifications, then enable Nearby devices or phone alarm sound.
Allow precise scheduling, including while your phone sleeps.
Show Stop and Snooze controls when an alert fires.
Also play your phone’s alarm sound for up to two minutes. Check your alarm volume. Each wrist signal may arrive a few seconds after expiry.
Nearby devices access is needed for wrist vibrations. Phone alarm sound can work on its own.
Choose a duration from one second to seven days.
Starting a new timer replaces the current countdown.
Alerts stop after two minutes. A vibration write already sent to the Air may finish.
Choose a time and optional repeat days. Your phone schedules the alert and sends a signal to the Air.

The current connection does not provide reliable tap events. Dismiss these alerts on your phone. Native Fitbit alarms can be dismissed by double-tapping, but Air Signals cannot program those alarms yet.
These timers and alarms belong to Air Signals. Google Clock and Samsung Clock alerts are not mirrored. Clock integration and tap-to-start activities need separate device validation.
Could not update the timer or alarm.
Mute while phone screen is on
Skip Fitbit notification vibrations while your phone is awake, including on the lock screen. Changes apply immediately.

Skipped alerts are discarded. New notifications can vibrate again when your phone sleeps. Always On Display does not count as awake. Manual pattern previews still work. A vibration already sent to the Air may finish.
Phone screen on · notification vibrations muted
Assign a distinct wrist signal to the notifications you care about.
Choose All apps and assign a signal. Tap Save to apply your changes.
No enabled apps match your search.
Choose up to five apps. Turn another app Off first.
Could not load apps. Reopen this screen to try again.
Each group may contain several buzzes. Bluetooth adds some delay to the gaps.
Stop alerts before previewing a signal.
This sends the signal to your Air now. Each group may buzz several times. Your original vibration strength is checked afterward.
Stopping. A write already in progress can finish its strength check.
Signal finished. Original vibration strength verified: %1$s.
Air Signals uses app identity and timing. It does not read message text, titles or senders, and has no internet permission.

Android grants notification access system-wide. Air Signals uses only app identity and timing for apps you select. It does not read or store message text, titles, senders or contacts, and has no internet permission.

Nearby notifications from the same app are combined. Queued alerts expire after 45 seconds, with a 5-second cooldown after each delivery. Failed deliveries pause alerts. Open the app and start alerts again after restarting your phone.
Stop alerts to read your Air’s model, firmware or vibration strength.
Could not start alerts. Check permissions and try again.
